_description: Shared input field tokens. Layered structural (shape + per-corner/side) + colour bucket with implicit category (no /color/ prefix). Used by text-field, textarea, dropdown, datepicker.
_verification: TRATON modes verified via REST 2026-08-05 for the 28 cluster-6 tokens — all exist in the TRATON collection, every Light/Dark value matches this spec. NOT covered: icon/control-default + icon/control-hover (added later by cluster #11a work). Scania modes pending for all tokens (REST cannot read child-collection variables; verify via Plugin API or Variables panel), so confidence stays Proposed until then. border/focus-* (4 tokens, Deprecate) confirmed absent in Figma and removed from this spec 2026-08-07 — focus is owned by the -focus helper.

variables.name: component/-input/border/radius-bottom-left
variables.comment: PER-CORNER — TRATON default, Scania none (underline-bar shape).

variables.name: component/-input/border/width-bottom
variables.comment: PER-SIDE — both brands use default (the underline side for Scania).

variables.name: component/-input/background/primary
variables.comment: Primary mode background. Base surface context — no state variants (hover/error/etc don't change bg). Matches message/primary naming.

variables.name: component/-input/background/secondary
variables.comment: Secondary mode background. Base surface context — no state variants. Matches message/secondary naming.

variables.name: component/-input/text/error-default
variables.comment: Generic error-state text colour (highlight/danger treatment). Same principle as icon/error-default. Currently bound to helper text in the error variant. Future brands can alias text/label-default to text/error-default to extend the red treatment to labels. The variant on canvas (State=Error) communicates context; the token provides the brand-override anchor.

variables.name: component/-input/border/error-default
variables.comment: Border colour when input is in error validation variant, default interaction state. Nested matches chip/button convention.

variables.name: component/-input/border/success-default
variables.comment: Border colour when input is in success validation variant, default interaction state.

variables.name: component/-input/icon/prefix-default
variables.comment: Prefix icon/text (leading). Uses defined level — visible, meaningful, secondary to value. Verify contrast.

variables.name: component/-input/icon/suffix-default
variables.comment: Suffix icon/text (trailing). Same level as prefix — unified treatment for all prefix/suffix content.

variables.name: component/-input/icon/control-default
variables.comment: Interactive icon hosted in an input slot, as opposed to a static adornment. Named for its role, matching prefix/suffix/error, rather than for any one affordance. The system already draws this line: adornments carry default + disabled (datetime's calendar and clock icons), controls carry default + hover. First consumer is the Dropdown clear affordance ('x' emptying the filter text or selection), which lives in the Input/Slot/Suffix helper as a boolean, hidden by default. Brand-mode-split per convention-brand-mode-split-single-token: TRATON path color/icon/subtle (tegel-lite --dropdown-clear-icon), Scania path color/icon/strong (Scania core --tds-dropdown-clear-icon-color, its ink-scale treatment). Note this is the first brand-split icon token in -input; prefix, suffix and error are all brand-uniform.

variables.name: component/-input/icon/control-hover
variables.comment: Value-coincident with control-default today — both bridges confirm no hover divergence (Scania core: identical hex both states; tegel-lite: no hover override, only a focus outline). Ships as a separate token because carrying a hover state is what distinguishes a control from an adornment; the lever needs to exist even while the values match.

variables.name: component/-input/icon/error-default
variables.comment: Icon colour when input is in error validation variant, default interaction state. The error indicator icon that appears alongside the field.

variables.name: component/-input/opacity/disabled
variables.comment: Opacity for disabled state. Applied at component level.
